title: 第38课 · 你到底去不去
subtitle: Lesson 38 — 你到底去不去 · Are you going or not

items.py: Nǐ dàodǐ qù bu qù?
items.en: Are you going or not? (after all)

items.zh: 这件事你到底怎么想的？
items.py: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ dàodǐ zěnme xiǎng de?
items.en: What do you really think about this?

items.py: Nǐ jiūjìng xiǎng shuō shénme?
items.en: What exactly do you want to say?

items.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
items.py: Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

items.zh: 要是你不同意，就告诉我。
items.py: Yàoshi nǐ bù tóngyì, jiù gàosu wǒ.
items.en: If you don't agree, tell me.

items.py: Lián tā dōu bù zhīdào.
items.en: Even he doesn't know.

items.zh: 刘京：周末我们去爬长城吧。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Zhōumò wǒmen qù pá Chángchéng ba.
items.en: Liu Jing: Let's climb the Great Wall this weekend.

items.zh: 大卫：好啊。可是如果下雨呢？
items.py: Dàwèi: Hǎo a. Kěshì rúguǒ xià yǔ ne?
items.en: David: Sure. But what if it rains?

items.zh: 刘京：要是下雨，我们就去博物馆。你到底去不去？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Yàoshi xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù bówùguǎn. Nǐ dàodǐ qù bu qù?
items.en: Liu Jing: If it rains, we'll go to a museum. So are you going or not?

items.py: Dàwèi: Qù! Yīdìng qù.
items.en: David: Yes! Definitely.

items.zh: 刘京：好，我叫玛丽和和子也一起去。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Hǎo, wǒ jiào Mǎlì hé Hézǐ yě yīqǐ qù.
items.en: Liu Jing: Good, I'll ask Mary and Hezi to come too.

items.zh: 大卫：连和子都去吗？太好了！
items.py: Dàwèi: Lián Hézǐ dōu qù ma? Tài hǎo le!
items.en: David: Even Hezi is going? Great!

items.zh: 玛丽：你到底想学什么专业？
items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng xué shénme zhuānyè?
items.en: Mary: What major do you actually want to study?

items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ hái méi juédìng ne.
items.en: Hezi: I haven't decided yet.

items.zh: 玛丽：如果你喜欢中国文化，可以学汉语专业。
items.py: Mǎlì: Rúguǒ nǐ xǐhuan Zhōngguó wénhuà, kěyǐ xué Hànyǔ zhuānyè.
items.en: Mary: If you like Chinese culture, you could study Chinese.

items.zh: 和子：我也想过。可是学经济也很有用。
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ yě xiǎng guo. Kěshì xué jīngjì yě hěn yǒu yòng.
items.en: Hezi: I've thought about it. But economics is also useful.

items.zh: 玛丽：不管学什么，最重要的是喜欢。
items.py: Mǎlì: Bùguǎn xué shénme, zuì zhòngyào de shì xǐhuan.
items.en: Mary: No matter what you study, the most important thing is to like it.

items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐ shuō de duì.
items.en: Hezi: You're right.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (如果/要是...就 Conditionals)

items.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
items.py: Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

items.py: Yàoshi nǐ bú qù, wǒ yě bú qù.
items.en: If you don't go, I won't either.

items.zh: 如果有时间，我想去旅行。
items.py: Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ xiǎng qù lǚxíng.
items.en: If I have time, I want to travel.

items.py: Lián xiǎo háizi dōu huì shuō zhège.
items.en: Even children can say this. (连...都)

items.zh: 不管多忙，他都坚持学习。
items.py: Bùguǎn duō máng, tā dōu jiānchí xuéxí.
items.en: No matter how busy, he persists in studying.

items.zh: 你到底去不去？→ 你到底买不买？
items.py: Nǐ dàodǐ qù bu qù? → Nǐ dàodǐ mǎi bu mǎi?
items.en: Going or not? → Buying or not?

items.zh: 如果你累了，就休息一下。
items.py: Rúguǒ nǐ lèi le, jiù xiūxi yīxià.
items.en: If you're tired, take a rest.

items.py: Yàoshi yǒu wèntí, jiù wèn wǒ.
items.en: If you have questions, ask me.

items.py: Lián lǎoshī dōu bù zhīdào dá'àn.
items.en: Even the teacher doesn't know the answer.

items.zh: 不管天气怎么样，我都去。
items.py: Bùguǎn tiānqì zěnmeyàng, wǒ dōu qù.
items.en: No matter the weather, I'll go.
